verdict.rationale: The docs describe the Agent SDK for building agents on Claude Code's tools with full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions. Claude Code can also run as a stdio MCP server (`claude mcp serve`) and be scripted in CI or Unix pipelines, which gives it programmatic entry points beyond the interactive UI. Missing for 10: the SDK is covered by only a single overview sentence, with no API reference, endpoint or method details, versioning or stability guarantees, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving it programmatically.
